payload.text: I ___ to London three times in my life.
payload.explanation_uz: Hayotdagi tajriba aniq vaqtsiz Present Perfect (have + V3) bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: She ___ her keys yesterday and had to call a locksmith. (lose)
payload.explanation_uz: 'yesterday' aniq o'tgan vaqtni bildiradi, shuning uchun Past Simple ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I ___ for two hours, so I'm really tired. (work)
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgacha davom etgan va natijasi seziladigan harakat Present Perfect Continuous (have been + V-ing) bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ at home. (stay)
payload.explanation_uz: Birinchi shartli gapda if-qismi Present Simple, natija qismi will + fe'l bo'ladi.

payload.text: If I ___ more time, I would learn Spanish.
payload.explanation_uz: Ikkinchi shartli gapda if-qismi Past Simple, natija qismi would + fe'l bo'ladi.

payload.text: English ___ all over the world. (speak)
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgi zamon majhul nisbati: am/is/are + V3.

payload.text: This bridge ___ in 1995. (build)
payload.explanation_uz: O'tgan zamon majhul nisbati: was/were + V3.

payload.text: He said that he ___ very tired. (be)
payload.explanation_uz: Ko'chirma gapda Present Simple odatda Past Simple ga o'tadi (am -> was).

payload.text: She asked me, 'Where do you live?' She asked me where I ___. (live)
payload.explanation_uz: Ko'chirma so'roq gapda so'z tartibi darak gapdagidek bo'ladi va zamon bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi (live -> lived).

payload.text: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
payload.explanation_uz: Odamlarga nisbatan ega vazifasidagi nisbiy olmosh who (yoki that) ishlatiladi.

payload.text: This is the restaurant ___ we had dinner last week.
payload.explanation_uz: Joyni bildiruvchi nisbiy gapda where ishlatiladi.

payload.text: When I was a child, I ___ play football every day.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi takrorlanuvchi odat 'used to + fe'l' yoki 'would + fe'l' bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
payload.explanation_uz: Faraz qilishda: kuchli ishonch bilan inkor 'can't be', ijob 'must be' bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.text: I wish I ___ a car, but I can't afford one.
payload.explanation_uz: Hozirgi zamondagi afsus 'wish + Past Simple' bilan ifodalanadi: I wish I had.

payload.text: I enjoy ___ to music in the evening.
payload.explanation_uz: enjoy fe'lidan keyin gerund (V-ing) ishlatiladi.

payload.text: She decided ___ a new job. (find)
payload.explanation_uz: decide fe'lidan keyin infinitive (to + fe'l) ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I ___ in the garden when it started to rain. (sit)
payload.explanation_uz: Boshqa harakat bilan to'xtatilgan davomli harakat Past Continuous (was/were + V-ing) bilan beriladi.

payload.text: While we ___ dinner, the lights went out. (have)
payload.explanation_uz: 'While' bilan uzoq davom etgan fon harakati Past Continuous da, qisqa harakat Past Simple da bo'ladi.

payload.text: I can't go out. I have too ___ work to do.
payload.explanation_uz: Sanalmaydigan ot (work) bilan too much ishlatiladi; too many sanaladigan otlar uchun.

payload.text: How ___ does a ticket to Tashkent cost?
payload.explanation_uz: Narxni so'rashda 'how much' ishlatiladi.

payload.text: Please turn the volume ___; I can't hear the film.
payload.explanation_uz: 'turn up' - ovozni balandlatish ma'nosidagi phrasal verb.

payload.text: We couldn't go out ___ the rain.
payload.explanation_uz: Ot oldidan sabab bildirish uchun 'because of' (yoki 'due to') ishlatiladi, 'because' esa gap bilan keladi.

payload.text: He is very tired, ___ he is still working.
payload.explanation_uz: Zid ma'noni bog'lash uchun but yoki yet bog'lovchisi ishlatiladi.

payload.text: I've lived here ___ 2015.
payload.explanation_uz: Boshlanish nuqtasi (aniq yil) bilan Present Perfect da since ishlatiladi, davr bilan esa for.

payload.text: I don't know ___ he will come.
payload.explanation_uz: Ha/yo'q savolini ko'chirma yoki bilvosita gapga aylantirishda if yoki whether ishlatiladi.

payload.question: I ___ my homework yet.
payload.explanation_uz: 'yet' bilan inkor gapda Present Perfect (haven't + V3) ishlatiladi.

payload.question: We ___ to the cinema last night.
payload.explanation_uz: 'last night' aniq o'tgan vaqt, shuning uchun Past Simple (went) kerak.

payload.question: If she ___ harder, she would pass the exam.
payload.explanation_uz: Ikkinchi shartli gap: if + Past Simple, would + fe'l.

payload.question: Bread ___ in this bakery every morning.
payload.explanation_uz: Bread harakatni bajarmaydi, unga harakat qilinadi; hozirgi majhul nisbat: is + V3.

payload.question: 'I will call you,' he said. -> He said that he ___ me.
payload.explanation_uz: Ko'chirma gapda will -> would ga o'zgaradi.

payload.question: The book ___ I bought yesterday is great.
payload.explanation_uz: Narsaga nisbatan nisbiy olmosh which (yoki that) ishlatiladi.

payload.question: I ___ smoke, but I stopped last year.
payload.explanation_uz: O'tmishdagi, endi mavjud bo'lmagan odat 'used to + fe'l' bilan beriladi.

payload.question: She has been working all day. She ___ be exhausted.
payload.explanation_uz: Kuchli ijobiy faraz modal 'must be' bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.question: He suggested ___ to the beach.
payload.explanation_uz: suggest fe'lidan keyin gerund (V-ing) ishlatiladi.

payload.question: I'm used to ___ up early.
payload.explanation_uz: 'be used to' dan keyin gerund (V-ing) keladi va 'ko'nikkan' ma'nosini beradi.

payload.question: I ___ home when I saw an old friend.
payload.explanation_uz: Boshqa qisqa voqea bilan kesilgan harakat Past Continuous bilan ifodalanadi.

payload.question: We have ___ time, so let's hurry.
payload.explanation_uz: time sanalmaydigan ot; 'little' kam, yetarli emas ma'nosini beradi (few/many sanaladigan otlar uchun).

payload.question: He decided to ___ smoking.
payload.explanation_uz: 'give up' - biror odatni tashlash ma'nosidagi phrasal verb.

payload.question: ___ it was raining, we went for a walk.
payload.explanation_uz: Although + to'liq gap zid ma'noni bildiradi; despite dan keyin gap emas, ot yoki V-ing keladi.

payload.question: You ___ pay to enter; it's free.
payload.explanation_uz: 'don't have to' - majburiyat yo'qligini bildiradi, mustn't esa taqiqlaydi.
